style.styleTitle: Everlands Alpine Fir 6ft Slim Pre Lit Snowy Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Perfect for creating a winter wonderland ambiance, this Everlands 6ft Alpine pre-lit Snowy Christmas Tree brings festive cheer to any space. Crafted with realistic PE needles, this snowy-finish tree captures the beauty of a snow-dusted forest scene in the comfort of home. These lights, beautifully spaced 25 cm apart, offer 8 functions to customise the perfect Christmas glow, all controlled effortlessly through a foot switch. The green cable complements the tree's lush appearance, while the stable 25 cm metal foot ensures it stands securely.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>• 6ft height with a 41 cm diameter<br>• Snowy finish with realistic PE real needle construction<br>• 150 warm white micro LED lighting with eight twinkle functions<br>• Convenient foot switch operation with an 8-hour timer<br>• Sturdy 25 cm metal foot for stability<br><br>This tree is a delightful centrepiece, spreading Christmas magic and joy with the charm of its twinkling lights.<br></p>
